identity.seed: Common Ground's weeks laid again by the exact solver with their rest days and their early and late weeks held, so only which week works which time is chosen (exact-rota.py, SKELETON=common-ground.json with FAMILY=1, OBJ=gentle, ONE_MIN=18): the fewest neighbouring weeks starting at 06:20 or 15:45 on the same weekday, then the fewest week-to-week moves of over two hours, then the fewest neighbouring weeks sharing any other weekday start, then the gentlest change of start
identity.lineage: Today's 20-week link taken to 26 weeks on the brief of 4 Nov 2026, with its shift times varied from week to week as asked on 5 Nov 2026: the closing weeks and the opening weeks had sat side by side — four weeks of 15:45 closers in a row — which makes swapping with colleagues harder. Its rest days, its early and late weeks and each day's duties are those of the Common Ground grid, so the leave, the weekends, the December rules and the fit to the trains are the same; what moves is which week works which time. No two closing weeks now fall together, for one fewer week on a single shift time (18 of 21) and a larger change of start from one week to the next.
